pages.title: Filth Propulsion
pages.text: Craft POP from poop blocks and gunpowder material.$(br2)Both gunpowder and King of Dragon Fruit work as gunpowder material.

pages.title: Acceleration and Explosion
pages.text: Send POP through a pipe made of poop empty logs. The empty logs keep pushing it, raising its speed and explosion radius.$(br2)When triggered, POP converts blocks in range according to its recipes.
